args.name: page
args.doc: The page: home, book or my-appointments.

moves.say: {go: book} as you start the sentence about that page: "Let's open the booking page."
moves.doc: Open one of the clinic's pages, ringing its link in the header first.

args.name: thing
args.doc: A part of the page by name: services, dentists, branches, visit-info, payment, insurance, parking, eating, aftercare, emergency, hours, policy, calendar, summary, appointments.

moves.say: {show: parking} at the start of the sentence that talks about it; it scrolls into view and is ringed.
moves.doc: Scroll to a part of the page and ring it; nothing changes. Opens the home page first for a part only it has.

args.name: service_id
args.doc: The service's id from clinic.json: consult, checkup, emergency, scaling, filling, rct, extraction, wisdom, aligner, whitening, implant, iopa, opg, cbct.

args.name: date
args.doc: The day shown, YYYY-MM-DD.

args.name: branch_id
args.doc: indiranagar or hsr; none for both.

args.name: dentist_id
args.doc: The dentist's id; none for a scan or for any dentist.

args.name: view
args.doc: The calendar's view.

moves.doc: On the booking page: pick the service, branch and dentist as the visitor would, put that dentist's (or the imaging room's) calendar on the day, and ring the free slots. Opens the booking page first.

args.name: date
args.doc: YYYY-MM-DD.

args.name: time
args.doc: HH:MM, 24-hour.

args.name: chair_id
args.doc: The chair the slot was computed on.

args.name: resource_id
args.doc: The imaging room, for a scan.

args.name: sittings
args.doc: A root canal's later sittings, each 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM branch_id chair_id'.

moves.doc: Select one free slot on the calendar and show the booking summary (price, preparation, sittings) with its Confirm button. Nothing is booked yet. Refused when the slot is no longer free.

args.name: booking_id
args.doc: The id the brain minted, DT-24117.

args.name: patient_id
args.doc: The verified patient, P-1001, or the new patient's id.

args.name: sitting_ids
args.doc: The ids of the later sittings, in order.

moves.doc: Book the held slot, after the patient's spoken yes: the appointment goes on the calendar and the confirmation shows. Refused when nothing is held, the patient is not verified, or the slot was taken.

args.name: field
args.doc: The box to point at: phone, code or name; none for the step the sign-in is on.

moves.say: {signin: phone} as you ask them to type their mobile number in the box on screen. You never fill, read back or hear a number or a code: the visitor types both.
moves.doc: Open the sign-in panel (on the booking page when a slot is held, else on My appointments) and ring the box the visitor types in next. Fills nothing: the visitor types the mobile number and the code themselves.

args.name: name
args.doc: A new patient's full name, as said.

moves.doc: For a phone number with no record: fill the new patient's name and register them.
On My appointments: scroll to one appointment's card and ring it.

args.name: fee
args.doc: The late-change fee in rupees, 0 when free.

args.name: date
args.doc: The new day, for a reschedule.

args.name: time
args.doc: The new time, for a reschedule.

moves.doc: On My appointments: open the change sheet on one card (old and new time, or the cancellation) with the policy line and fee, and its Confirm and Keep buttons. Nothing changes yet.
Make the change the sheet shows, after the patient's spoken yes. Refused when the new slot was taken.

args.name: reason
args.doc: One short line for the dentist, in English.

args.name: window
args.doc: When the call comes, as authored: within 30 minutes.

moves.doc: Show the callback request card: what the dentist will call about, how soon, and its reference. The dentist calls the signed-in patient's number on record; refused when nobody is signed in.

args.name: date
args.doc: YYYY-MM-DD.

moves.doc: Put one dentist's (or imaging room's) calendar on screen, on the day or its week, and ring it. Changes no selection.
